caption: The drawing depicts two ceramic vessels placed against a plain, light beige background. The larger vessel, positioned slightly to the right and above center, is a rounded pitcher with a wide mouth and flaring rim. Its body is decorated with the image of a standing stag rendered in shades of brown, with the animal's antlers and detail in a darker hue. The surface of the pitcher also features faint, light-colored etching suggesting the texture of trees or vegetation. Attached to the rim on the left side is a sculpted figure of a small brown monkey, clinging to the top with its arms. Below and to the left is a smaller, slender vase with a narrow opening and footed base, similarly topped with a small brown sculpted animal, possibly another monkey, perched over the edge. Both vessels are shaded with tones of beige, light brown, and cream, and the decoration on the vessels is executed in muted naturalistic colors. The drawing includes the name “Stanley Mouse” in small text near the lower right of the larger vessel.
title: Pottery Vase
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
